cohort: 11 pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 and died in the Ekurhuleni health district, South Africa, between October 2020 and March 2021.
finding: High rates of hypertension (67%), stillbirth (50%), preterm caesarean section (67%), and laboratory abnormalities were observed among the COVID-19 positive women who died.
mod_finding: Preterm caesarean section was performed in 67% of the COVID-19 positive women who died.
